events.title: 🌎 (Online/Free) Free English Conversation Club with global people
events.description: **📢IMPORTANT : CHECK THE SESSION TIME IN OUR WEBSITE(The time on the website and the meetup site may not match since we change it ocasionally)** **Hi there! My name is Chloe.** I'm a certified English teacher from United States. I wanted to make an online language club where people can practice foreign languages by having real casual conversation! I'm looking for people who want to practice conversational English by talking about interesting topics and hanging out with people from all over the world in a small online group. **Here are some examples of what our weekly topics might be like:** **"What would you do if you come across your crush?"** **"Have you ever done the MBTI test? If so, what is your personality type?"** **"Do you believe in love at first sight? Why or why not?"** **"What are you most worried about right now?** 💎Here are some details💎 ✔️ We meet via Zoom ✔️ The session will last for 1 hour and consists of 3 different rounds ✔️ Each round has different topics and discussion questions ✔️ Each round, the groups are randomly mixed, so you will have a chance to talk to different people every time ✔️ This isn't just about practicing English, but also about listening to different opinions and learning about different cultures **✔️ The participation is FREE** **❌ No credit card** **❌ No Ads** **📢IMPORTANT : CHECK THE SESSION TIME IN OUR WEBSITE(The time on the website and the meetup site may not match since we change it ocasionally)** 💎 How to Join 💎 1. [Click the link(here)](https://langclub.live/sessions) 2. [Sign up](https://langclub.live/signup) 3\. Click 'book' in the session that you want to participate\. 4\. Show up at the session time and click 'Join' in the session page (The Zoom invitation will be sent to your e-mail once you apply too) 5\. Enjoy practicing English with people from all over the world\! **📢IMPORTANT : CHECK THE SESSION TIME IN OUR WEBSITE(The time on the website and the meetup site may not match since we change it ocasionally)**

events.name: How to build an enterprise-grade AI software factory
events.title: How to build an enterprise-grade AI software factory
events.description: Join Matar Peles, Field CTO at Port, for a hands-on session on turning AI coding agents into a fully automated, end-to-end delivery pipeline. Learn how to build a unified context layer, set up step-by-step factory agents, implement human-in-the-loop approvals for high-risk paths, and track pipeline efficiency, taking a ticket directly to pull request live. We'll dig into: - **Setting up the factory itself:** map the full process end to end, from the moment work arrives to the moment it ships, so the line has defined steps instead of disconnected automations. - **A unified context layer:** pull signals from the tools your teams already run into the shared source of truth every agent reasons over: services, owners, dependencies and the standards that apply to each. - **Factory agents for each step:** onboard an agent per step with a named owner and a scope of what it can touch, so you can connect the next one without rebuilding the line. - **Human in the loop gates:** name which paths carry enough risk to stop for a person, route each one to whoever owns it, and write their decision back before the work moves on. - **Insights and optimization:** track what the line ships, how much of it ran without a human, and which step is holding everything up. Speaker: Matar Peles Field CTO, Port Matar Peles is a field CTO at Port, where he shapes how the company connects product and market and guides its technical strategy in the field. He works closely with customers and internal teams to translate real-world needs into product direction, helping ensure Port delivers meaningful impact for engineering organizations. Matar focuses on improving productivity, clarity, and developer experience at scale while supporting teams in getting the most out of Port’s platform.

events.name: Make a Friend Picnic
events.title: Make a Friend Picnic
events.description: Most importantly: you’re all awesome. You signed up to a stranger’s event because you wanted to make a friend. You put yourself out there to meet people you don’t know, which is hard, and you did it anyway. So thank you. That took guts, and I'm not going to let that go to waste. What to expect: 🦆 A giant game of duck duck goose (yes, as adults, and yes, you will run) 🧊 Icebreaker bingo, with gift bags full of goodies from our partners for the first 50 people to complete it 💕 General picnic wholesomeness What to bring: 🧺 Your own picnic setup, food and drinks included. Expecting others to provide for you ain't cool. Be cool & self sufficient. 🧺 Board games and card games, if you’re a nerd like me. Set them out on your blanket and invite people over to play. It’s the easiest way to make a friend. One more ask: I want to give back to the city that’s bringing us all together. If you’re able, please bring a donation for the Mission Neighborhood Resource Center (MNRC). They operate on a harm-reduction model focused on dignity, community-building, and meeting basic human needs while residents move toward greater stability and well-being. All services are bilingual, drop-in, and open to adults 18+. Learn more: https://www.mnhc.org/en/community-programs/resource-center What they need: 🙏Underwear (any gender, all adult sizes) 🙏Disposable razors 🙏Feminine hygiene products 🙏Travel-sized hygiene products (shampoo, conditioner, soap, toothpaste, hand sanitizer, toothbrushes) Please no other clothing, food, kids’ items, or anything used. Ground rules: 🛑 Be a decent human being. Respect everyone in attendance. If you’re a creep, I will shame you with the lilac megaphone I purchased for this event. 🛑 Emergencies: call 911. There will be a basic first aid kit, but that’s it. 🛑 Keep your dogs on leash. 🛑 Take your trash with you. Don’t make me clean up after you. I’m trying to be your friend, not your mom (not that she should be cleaning up after you either). Somehow this whole thing became news. The SF Standard wrote about the picnic: https://sfstandard.com/2026/09/12/viral-sf-picnic-city-permit/ Athena and I are excited to meet all of you! --- I'm still new to the Bay, and this is still the most extroverted thing an introvert can dream up: inviting a pile of strangers to come sit in the grass with me. My social battery is finite. My love of people, picnics, and the specific magic of introducing two people who end up becoming real friends is not. Bring your own picnic setup: a blanket, drinks, snacks, whatever makes sitting in the grass feel a little luxurious. I'll either be the redhead having a solo picnic reading something objectively terrible on Kindle Unlimited, or the redhead surrounded by people looking a little overwhelmed because this happened again. Athena, my dog, will be there too, asking you to throw her ball or slip her a snack. She has no shame about it. Either way, come say hi.

chapter.description:
🎉 Welcome to GDG on Campus University of Bristol!

We’re a student-run community for anyone curious about technology and the ideas it can bring to life. Whether you’re writing your first line of code, building a project or simply wondering where to start, you’re welcome here. No prior experience is needed.

Our vision

We want to make it easier for students at Bristol to learn together, meet people and use technology to make a difference. Our community is a space to ask questions, share ideas and find support as you turn those ideas into real projects.

Now in our fourth year, we’re excited to keep building a community that future students can grow.

💡 What’s in store?

  • Hands-on workshops: Try new technologies and build practical skills with support from others.

  • Speaker sessions: Hear about developer careers, internships, applications and interviews from people with firsthand experience.

  • Technical talks: Explore topics such as TensorFlow, Android development and Go.

  • Social events: Meet students who share your interests, make friends and find potential project partners.

Whether you’re interested in software development, tech and business, or an idea that could help your community, there’s a place for you at GDG on Campus.

🤝 Collaborate with us

We’d love to hear from GDG leads at other universities, potential speakers and anyone interested in hosting an event or working with our community.

📲 Join and stay in touch

Click the “Join” button on this page to stay updated on upcoming events. You may need to create a GDG profile first, then return to this page to join.

Email: gdscbristol@gmail.com
Instagram: @gdscbristol

Let’s learn, build and grow together! 🙌

chapter.description:
Our Mission: Connecting and Growing Baltimore's Developers

Google Developer Group (GDG) Baltimore is a local community for developers to connect and learn together. We are a volunteer-run group, supported by Google, with a mission to build a strong, inclusive, and skilled tech community in the heart of Maryland.

This global community prides itself on being an inclusive environment. We welcome everyone interested in tech, from beginners to experienced developers.

What We Do: Your Hub for Google Technology

We host a variety of events tailored to the interests of the Baltimore tech scene, from downtown startups to the academic hubs at local universities. Our events provide hands-on learning, expert insights, and invaluable networking opportunities.

Our key initiatives include:

  • Build with AI: These community-led, hands-on events help developers of all skill levels (including backend, Android, and Flutter) acquire and apply Generative AI skills using Gemini, Gemma, and Vertex AI.

  • Road to Google Developers Certification: We provide the resources and community support to help you prepare for and earn professional Google Cloud certifications, such as Cloud Architect, Data Engineer, and Machine Learning Engineer.

  • StartathonAI: An AI-powered startup immersive experience where participants use LLMs to build comprehensive business plans and compete in a pitch competition judged by VCs and industry experts.

  • Building for Everyone: In partnership with Google's Accessibility teams, we run events to educate developers on incorporating accessibility best practices and tools into their products.

  • Social & Networking Events: Connect with your peers at our "Tap and Tech" or "Small Business AI Clinique" events.

Who Should Join?

Our community is a vibrant mix of:

  • Students from University of Maryland, Baltimore County (UMBC), Johns Hopkins University, University of Baltimore, MICA, CCBC, BCCC, and other local institutions.

  • Professionals working in Baltimore's thriving tech, cybersecurity, health-tech, and government contracting sectors.

  • Startup Founders and entrepreneurs looking to leverage AI and Cloud technologies.

  • Career Changers and new developers seeking to build foundational skills.

  • Anyone curious about the future of technology!

Join GDG Baltimore today to connect with your local tech community, get free access to courses and Google Cloud credits, and build the next generation of technology.


Disclaimer: GDG Baltimore is an independent group; our activities and the opinions expressed here should in no way be linked to Google, the corporation. To learn more about the GDG program, visit https://developers.google.com/community/gdg

chapter.description:
🇫🇷 Version Française

GDG Marseille : La tech, l'expertise Google, l'esprit marseillais.

Bienvenue au GDG Marseille. Ici, on connecte le savoir-faire mondial de Google à la dynamique de notre ville. 🚀

Peu importe votre titre — développeur, data scientist, designer, étudiant ou simple curieux — vous avez votre place. On ne croit pas aux hiérarchies, mais à la curiosité et au partage. Notre mission est simple : rassembler les talents locaux pour faire de Marseille un point de rencontre incontournable de la tech.

Ce qu’on fait ensemble :

  • 💡 Workshops & Hackathons : Pratiquez l'IA, le Cloud, Flutter ou Android avec des experts.

  • 🤝 Meetups & Networking : Rencontrez ceux qui font bouger l'écosystème à Marseille.

  • 🚀 Talks : Profitez de retours d'expérience concrets et sans langue de bois.

  • 🎯 Confiance & Growth : Progressez, partagez vos idées et élargissez votre réseau professionnel.

Rejoignez-nous. Apprenez. Partagez. On ne construit pas seulement des apps, on construit l'avenir de la tech dans le Sud.

Partenariats & Sponsoring

Vous voulez aider la communauté à grandir et gagner en visibilité ? Startups, entreprises ou écoles, discutons-en pour bâtir la suite ensemble.

Clause de non-responsabilité

Le GDG Marseille est un groupe indépendant. Nos activités et opinions sont les nôtres et ne sont pas liées à Google, la corporation. Pour en savoir plus : https://developers.google.com/community/gdg

chapter.description:
Our Mission: Connecting and Growing Baltimore's Developers

Google Developer Group (GDG) Baltimore is a local community for developers to connect and learn together. We are a volunteer-run group, supported by Google, with a mission to build a strong, inclusive, and skilled tech community in the heart of Maryland.

This global community prides itself on being an inclusive environment. We welcome everyone interested in tech, from beginners to experienced developers.

What We Do: Your Hub for Google Technology

We host a variety of events tailored to the interests of the Baltimore tech scene, from downtown startups to the academic hubs at local universities. Our events provide hands-on learning, expert insights, and invaluable networking opportunities.

Our key initiatives include:

  • Build with AI: These community-led, hands-on events help developers of all skill levels (including backend, Android, and Flutter) acquire and apply Generative AI skills using Gemini, Gemma, and Vertex AI.

  • Road to Google Developers Certification: We provide the resources and community support to help you prepare for and earn professional Google Cloud certifications, such as Cloud Architect, Data Engineer, and Machine Learning Engineer.

  • StartathonAI: An AI-powered startup immersive experience where participants use LLMs to build comprehensive business plans and compete in a pitch competition judged by VCs and industry experts.

  • Building for Everyone: In partnership with Google's Accessibility teams, we run events to educate developers on incorporating accessibility best practices and tools into their products.

  • Social & Networking Events: Connect with your peers at our "Tap and Tech" or "Small Business AI Clinique" events.

Who Should Join?

Our community is a vibrant mix of:

  • Students from University of Maryland, Baltimore County (UMBC), Johns Hopkins University, University of Baltimore, MICA, CCBC, BCCC, and other local institutions.

  • Professionals working in Baltimore's thriving tech, cybersecurity, health-tech, and government contracting sectors.

  • Startup Founders and entrepreneurs looking to leverage AI and Cloud technologies.

  • Career Changers and new developers seeking to build foundational skills.

  • Anyone curious about the future of technology!

Join GDG Baltimore today to connect with your local tech community, get free access to courses and Google Cloud credits, and build the next generation of technology.

谷歌开发者社区GDG（Google Developers Groups）是谷歌开发者部门发起的全球项目，由当地热爱谷歌开发技术的开发者自愿组织，诣在推动和学习 Google技术 和开源、开放先进技术的开放性、公益性社区。 天津谷歌开发者社区成立于2014年11月1日。

欢迎你来到天津谷歌开发者社区！ 我们是来自位于中国天津市的开发者们、企业经理们、高校教师们和大学生们。天津是中国的四个直辖市之一、也是中国北部渤海湾边最大的港口城市、属于渤海经济发展区的一部分。天津正在演变成一个国际航运和物流、现代制造业和研发的枢纽城市。天津也是具有很多学府的城市，包括著名的南开大学和天津大学。我们谷歌的粉丝，我们爱好学习和利用各种谷歌开发技术，去开发基于互联网和移动应用平台上的各种新产品和新型商业服务和创新。 我们是一个开放和自由的社区，任何人都可以来加入。我们的目标是通过举办各种互相帮助和分享的活动，交流开发心得和经验，学习各种谷歌开发技术、开源代码技术、公开网络标准技术等等，来推动互联网应用和移动应用的创新和创业。 欢迎你来加入我们这个开放的社区！

chapter.description:
Our Mission: Connecting and Growing Baltimore's Developers

Google Developer Group (GDG) Baltimore is a local community for developers to connect and learn together. We are a volunteer-run group, supported by Google, with a mission to build a strong, inclusive, and skilled tech community in the heart of Maryland.

This global community prides itself on being an inclusive environment. We welcome everyone interested in tech, from beginners to experienced developers.

What We Do: Your Hub for Google Technology

We host a variety of events tailored to the interests of the Baltimore tech scene, from downtown startups to the academic hubs at local universities. Our events provide hands-on learning, expert insights, and invaluable networking opportunities.

Our key initiatives include:

  • Build with AI: These community-led, hands-on events help developers of all skill levels (including backend, Android, and Flutter) acquire and apply Generative AI skills using Gemini, Gemma, and Vertex AI.

  • Road to Google Developers Certification: We provide the resources and community support to help you prepare for and earn professional Google Cloud certifications, such as Cloud Architect, Data Engineer, and Machine Learning Engineer.

  • StartathonAI: An AI-powered startup immersive experience where participants use LLMs to build comprehensive business plans and compete in a pitch competition judged by VCs and industry experts.

  • Building for Everyone: In partnership with Google's Accessibility teams, we run events to educate developers on incorporating accessibility best practices and tools into their products.

  • Social & Networking Events: Connect with your peers at our "Tap and Tech" or "Small Business AI Clinique" events.

Who Should Join?

Our community is a vibrant mix of:

  • Students from University of Maryland, Baltimore County (UMBC), Johns Hopkins University, University of Baltimore, MICA, CCBC, BCCC, and other local institutions.

  • Professionals working in Baltimore's thriving tech, cybersecurity, health-tech, and government contracting sectors.

  • Startup Founders and entrepreneurs looking to leverage AI and Cloud technologies.

  • Career Changers and new developers seeking to build foundational skills.

  • Anyone curious about the future of technology!

Join GDG Baltimore today to connect with your local tech community, get free access to courses and Google Cloud credits, and build the next generation of technology.

Welcome to Google Developers Group (GDG) Ahlen - Where Innovation Thrives! 

🌟 Whether online or in-person, our events are crafted to inspire, educate, and connect individuals passionate about technology and innovation. 

💡Why Join GDG Ahlen?

🔥Join us at Google Developer Group Ahlen in NRW, Germany, and be part of a dynamic community of tech enthusiasts, lifelong learners, and forward-thinking developers. 

  • 🌍 Ahlen is a city that distinctively blends rich history with a forward-thinking spirit. 
  • 🐘 Our most unique local symbol is the Mammoth , commemorating the prehistoric woolly mammoth fossils discovered right here. This connection to ancient discovery provides a powerful backdrop for your modern innovations.
  • 📹 Our YouTube channel @GDGAhlen 

What Awaits You at GDG Ahlen

  • Insightful Tech Talks & Sessions: Learn directly from Google engineers, Google Developer Experts (GDEs), and industry leaders. 
  • Dive deep into the practical integration of AI 🧠 and Cloud ☁️ technologies, exploring best practices, new tools, and successful implementation strategies. 
  • Hands-On Workshops, Hackathons, Get certified sessions, Codelabs: Move beyond theory and gain practical skills! Participate in interactive sessions where you can experiment with the latest AI/Cloud platforms and tools to build innovative and scalable applications. 
  • Focus on Responsible Innovation: Engage in crucial discussions and learn techniques for building ethically sound AI solutions. Explore topics like fairness, transparency, privacy, and the responsible scaling of AI-driven systems. 
  • Deep Dives into Architecture: Understand how to design robust, scalable, and future-proof systems leveraging the power of Cloud infrastructure combined with AI capabilities.
  • Vibrant Networking Opportunities: Connect with hundreds of passionate developers from your local community and potentially beyond. Share knowledge, discuss challenges, collaborate on ideas, and build valuable professional connections. 
  • Exploring the Latest Tools: Discover the newest Google developer tools and platforms designed to streamline AI development and Cloud deployment, enhancing your productivity and capabilities. 

No matter where you are in your coding journey—whether you're a beginner exploring your first programming language or a seasoned developer tackling complex challenges—our community is here to support, inspire, and grow with you. 💡

Let’s learn, share, and create the future of technology together! 🚀

Bienvenue au Google Developer Group Kinshasa

Le cœur battant de l'innovation technologique en RDC.

Nous sommes bien plus qu'une simple communauté. Le GDG Kinshasa est un mouvement de créateurs, de développeurs et de leaders passionnés par les technologies Google. Guidés par le parcours de nos aînés qui œuvrent déjà sur la scène mondiale, notre vision est double : faire de la technologie un puissant levier pour le développement de notre nation, et un tremplin pour propulser nos talents au sommet de l'industrie tech internationale.

Notre Mission en Action

Nous démocratisons l'accès à une connaissance de calibre mondial. À travers des conférences de haut niveau, des ateliers pratiques et des hackathons conçus pour répondre aux standards internationaux, nous vous équipons avec les compétences les plus recherchées sur le marché global. GDG Melbourne is for anyone interested in developing and learning about Android and other exciting Google related technologies. We cover such topics as Kotlin, Java, Flutter, Firebase, Machine Learning, VR & AR, Google Assistant, Wearables and IoT.

Regardless of your skill level or experience, it's a fun and open environment, so we'd love to have you come along! Some of the events we hold are:

• Monthly Meetups
Melbourne CBD, on the last Wednesday of each month.
We typically have two lightning (10-15 minute) talks coupled with a longer (20-30 minute) presentation.  Each meetup also includes time to talk and network, a summary of new releases and local developer introductions. We often then head to a nearby pub. Catering is provided.

• Coding Nights
Melbourne CBD, on the second last Wednesday of each month.
Coding nights are hosted in a casual environment to allow you to network with like minded developers and work on your own projects. Experts, colleagues and peers are on hand to help you out with problems and to collaborate on projects. Catering is provided.

• Special events
Typically one-off events such as a Google I/O Extended (a recap of the event and announcements), Study Jams (free training sessions), DevFest (one day conference) or social events like Christmas parties.

Learn more on our website

Keep up to date on all thing GDG Melbourne or join the discussions on:

Welcome to Google Developers Group (GDG) Ahlen - Where Innovation Thrives! 

🌟 Whether online or in-person, our events are crafted to inspire, educate, and connect individuals passionate about technology and innovation. 

💡Why Join GDG Ahlen?

🔥Join us at Google Developer Group Ahlen in NRW, Germany, and be part of a dynamic community of tech enthusiasts, lifelong learners, and forward-thinking developers. 

  • 🌍 Ahlen is a city that distinctively blends rich history with a forward-thinking spirit. 
  • 🐘 Our most unique local symbol is the Mammoth , commemorating the prehistoric woolly mammoth fossils discovered right here. This connection to ancient discovery provides a powerful backdrop for your modern innovations.
  • 📹 Our YouTube channel @GDGAhlen 

What Awaits You at GDG Ahlen

  • Insightful Tech Talks & Sessions: Learn directly from Google engineers, Google Developer Experts (GDEs), and industry leaders. 
  • Dive deep into the practical integration of AI 🧠 and Cloud ☁️ technologies, exploring best practices, new tools, and successful implementation strategies. 
  • Hands-On Workshops, Hackathons, Get certified sessions, Codelabs: Move beyond theory and gain practical skills! Participate in interactive sessions where you can experiment with the latest AI/Cloud platforms and tools to build innovative and scalable applications. 
  • Focus on Responsible Innovation: Engage in crucial discussions and learn techniques for building ethically sound AI solutions. Explore topics like fairness, transparency, privacy, and the responsible scaling of AI-driven systems. 
  • Deep Dives into Architecture: Understand how to design robust, scalable, and future-proof systems leveraging the power of Cloud infrastructure combined with AI capabilities.
  • Vibrant Networking Opportunities: Connect with hundreds of passionate developers from your local community and potentially beyond. Share knowledge, discuss challenges, collaborate on ideas, and build valuable professional connections. 
  • Exploring the Latest Tools: Discover the newest Google developer tools and platforms designed to streamline AI development and Cloud deployment, enhancing your productivity and capabilities. 

No matter where you are in your coding journey—whether you're a beginner exploring your first programming language or a seasoned developer tackling complex challenges—our community is here to support, inspire, and grow with you. 💡

Let’s learn, share, and create the future of technology together! 🚀


Disclaimer: GDG Ahlen is an independent group. Our activities and views are not officially linked to Google, the corporation. Learn more about the GDG program at developers.google.com/community/gdg

🇫🇷 Le Google Developer Group (GDG) Aix-en-Provence, c’est bien plus qu’une communauté tech : c’est un espace créatif où l’innovation rime avec connexion, et où chaque passionné.e trouve sa place. 🚀

Que tu sois dev, designer, data scientist, expert.e en cloud ou cybersécurité, ou simplement curieux.se de comprendre comment la tech transforme notre monde : tu es ici chez toi.

Pour nous, les grandes idées ne naissent pas des titres ou des années d'expérience, mais de la curiosité, de l'entraide et de l'audace. C’est pour ça que nos portes sont grandes ouvertes à tout le monde : des pros confirmés aux étudiants, en passant par les entrepreneurs, les débutants complets, et même les profils "non-tech" qui veulent apprendre et networker.

Ce qui t'attend chez nous :

💡 Workshops & Hackathons : De la pratique pure sur les technos Google.
🤝 Meetups & Networking : Pour créer des ponts entre toutes les disciplines.
🚀 Talks & Conférences : Avec des experts Google et les acteurs qui font bouger l'écosystème.
👨‍💻 Expériences Hands-on : IA, Cloud, Flutter, Firebase, Android... on met les mains dans le cambouis !
🎯 Chill & Fun : Soirées jeux, boîtes à idées, et moments détente (parce que c'est aussi ça, l'esprit GDG).

Mais l’essentiel est ailleurs : tu trouveras ici une communauté qui te soutient, te challenge et grandit avec toi à chaque étape. On ne construit pas seulement des systèmes techniques ; on bâtit des connexions, de la confiance et une vraie culture de l’innovation au cœur de la Provence.

Soutiens nos Causes et nos Projets 🌍

On ne veut pas seulement créer de la tech, on veut créer un futur qui a du sens.

Le monde change à une vitesse folle, et on est convaincus que la seule façon de protéger notre planète et nos systèmes, c'est de donner les moyens d'agir à ceux qui les construisent. En soutenant nos projets, tu ne fais pas qu'un simple "don" : tu investis dans les esprits qui résoudront les défis de demain.

Qu’il s’agisse d’offrir leurs premiers kits de dev à des étudiants passionnés ou de lancer des bootcamps pour transformer des idées folles en solutions locales, ton soutien fait de toi un acteur de l'histoire. Rejoins-nous pour bâtir une innovation qui prend soin du monde et qui n'oublie personne en chemin.

Deviens un moteur du changement ici : https://googledevgroupaix.com/support

Partenariats

Nous croyons au collectif. Si vous êtes une startup, une université ou une entreprise locale et que vous partagez notre mission d'inspirer et d'éduquer : bâtissons le futur ensemble.

GDG Cloud Nagpur is a community-driven group for developers, cloud practitioners, students, IT professionals, and technology enthusiasts who are passionate about learning, sharing, and building with modern technologies.

Our Mission

Our mission is to foster a collaborative learning environment where individuals can enhance their technical skills, connect with industry experts, and stay up to date with the latest advancements in:

  • Cloud Computing
  • Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning
  • DevOps
  • Kubernetes
  • Site Reliability Engineering (SRE)
  • Cybersecurity
  • Open Source
  • Other emerging technologies

Through regular meetups, workshops, hands-on sessions, study jams, hackathons, and community events, we provide opportunities for members to gain practical knowledge, share experiences, and grow both personally and professionally.

Whether you're just starting your technology journey or are an experienced professional, GDG Cloud Nagpur welcomes everyone who is eager to learn, contribute, and be part of a thriving technology community.

What We Do

  • Technical meetups and knowledge-sharing sessions
  • Hands-on workshops and learning programs
  • Cloud, AI, DevOps, and Open Source discussions
  • Community networking and collaboration opportunities
  • Career growth and mentorship initiatives
  • Industry expert talks and panel discussions
  • Hackathons, challenges, and innovation-driven events

Our Community

At GDG Cloud Nagpur, we believe that learning grows when knowledge is shared. Our community brings together curious minds, builders, developers, architects, students, and innovators to learn, connect, collaborate, and create impact through technology.

Whether you're a student taking your first steps into technology, a cloud developer building real-world solutions, or an experienced architect exploring the latest advancements, GDG Cloud Nagpur provides a space to learn, discuss, and grow together.

A place for students, cloud developers, and architects to come together to learn, discuss, and explore the latest advancements in cloud technologies.

We are Google Develover Group on Campus University of Belgrade!

We proudly present to you Google Developer Group on Campus, University of Belgrade! Our chapter was founded in 2020 at the School of Electrical Engineering. With their knowledge, skills, and ambition, chapter members have successfully organized many events. Our goal is to help our members achieve practical knowledge, improve their skills and learn from the experts in their field.

Active members are mostly students interested in Computer Science and Software Development. We encourage all of the students from the University of Belgrade to step out of their comfort zone and join our community! Connecting with students from different faculties can expand your views, deepen your relationships, lead to beautiful friendships, and unforgettable memories.

6 teams in unity!

All the credit, for our successful events, goes to our 6 teams. They put in a lot of work and effort, and receive great results in return. Our teams have separate tasks, but can’t function without each other!

🟥 Information Technology & Engineering Team

  • Solve technical problems and collaborate in hosting events in our community

  • Work on exciting projects and develop innovative ideas within GDG on Campus

🟦 Communications & Event Organization Team

  • Manage our external communications with companies and academic relations

  • Help planning, organizing, and hosting the events

🟩 Public Relations & Digital Marketing Team

  • Manage GDG on Campus social media platforms and improve our community exposure

  • Advise with other teams and publicize our achievements on social media

🟨 Digital Design & Video Editing Team

  • Create and customize our graphics portfolio for GDG on Campus social media posts

  • Collaborate with IT teams on UI/UX designs for various GDG on Campus projects

🟧 Human Resources & Community Care Team

  • Support the recruitment, onboarding, and engagement of GDG on Campus members

  • Maintain a healthy and motivating environment through team-building initiatives and feedback sessions

🟪 User Experience & Product Design Team

  • Design intuitive and user-friendly digital experiences for GDGoC projects

  • Collaborate with other teams to improve usability, accessibility, and product design solutions

Become a part of the community!

If you are interested in joining our community, you can simply fill out the application form! You can follow our work on the official Instagram and LinkedIn pages!

We encourage you to apply, work on yourselves, push your boundaries, and create wonderful memories!

chapter.description:
Our Mission: Connecting and Growing Baltimore's Developers

Google Developer Group (GDG) Baltimore is a local community for developers to connect and learn together. We are a volunteer-run group, supported by Google, with a mission to build a strong, inclusive, and skilled tech community in the heart of Maryland.

This global community prides itself on being an inclusive environment. We welcome everyone interested in tech, from beginners to experienced developers.

What We Do: Your Hub for Google Technology

We host a variety of events tailored to the interests of the Baltimore tech scene, from downtown startups to the academic hubs at local universities. Our events provide hands-on learning, expert insights, and invaluable networking opportunities.

Our key initiatives include:

  • Build with AI: These community-led, hands-on events help developers of all skill levels (including backend, Android, and Flutter) acquire and apply Generative AI skills using Gemini, Gemma, and Vertex AI.

  • Road to Google Developers Certification: We provide the resources and community support to help you prepare for and earn professional Google Cloud certifications, such as Cloud Architect, Data Engineer, and Machine Learning Engineer.

  • StartathonAI: An AI-powered startup immersive experience where participants use LLMs to build comprehensive business plans and compete in a pitch competition judged by VCs and industry experts.

  • Building for Everyone: In partnership with Google's Accessibility teams, we run events to educate developers on incorporating accessibility best practices and tools into their products.

  • Social & Networking Events: Connect with your peers at our "Tap and Tech" or "Small Business AI Clinique" events.

Who Should Join?

Our community is a vibrant mix of:

  • Students from University of Maryland, Baltimore County (UMBC), Johns Hopkins University, University of Baltimore, MICA, CCBC, BCCC, and other local institutions.

  • Professionals working in Baltimore's thriving tech, cybersecurity, health-tech, and government contracting sectors.

  • Startup Founders and entrepreneurs looking to leverage AI and Cloud technologies.

  • Career Changers and new developers seeking to build foundational skills.

  • Anyone curious about the future of technology!

Join GDG Baltimore today to connect with your local tech community, get free access to courses and Google Cloud credits, and build the next generation of technology.


Disclaimer: GDG Baltimore is an independent group; our activities and the opinions expressed here should in no way be linked to Google, the corporation. To learn more about the GDG program, visit https://developers.google.com/community/gdg

Welcome to Google Developers Group (GDG) Ahlen - Where Innovation Thrives! 

🌟 Whether online or in-person, our events are crafted to inspire, educate, and connect individuals passionate about technology and innovation. 

💡Why Join GDG Ahlen?

🔥Join us at Google Developer Group Ahlen in NRW, Germany, and be part of a dynamic community of tech enthusiasts, lifelong learners, and forward-thinking developers. 

  • 🌍 Ahlen is a city that distinctively blends rich history with a forward-thinking spirit. 
  • 🐘 Our most unique local symbol is the Mammoth , commemorating the prehistoric woolly mammoth fossils discovered right here. This connection to ancient discovery provides a powerful backdrop for your modern innovations.
  • 📹 Our YouTube channel @GDGAhlen 

What Awaits You at GDG Ahlen

  • Insightful Tech Talks & Sessions: Learn directly from Google engineers, Google Developer Experts (GDEs), and industry leaders. 
  • Dive deep into the practical integration of AI 🧠 and Cloud ☁️ technologies, exploring best practices, new tools, and successful implementation strategies. 
  • Hands-On Workshops, Hackathons, Get certified sessions, Codelabs: Move beyond theory and gain practical skills! Participate in interactive sessions where you can experiment with the latest AI/Cloud platforms and tools to build innovative and scalable applications. 
  • Focus on Responsible Innovation: Engage in crucial discussions and learn techniques for building ethically sound AI solutions. Explore topics like fairness, transparency, privacy, and the responsible scaling of AI-driven systems. 
  • Deep Dives into Architecture: Understand how to design robust, scalable, and future-proof systems leveraging the power of Cloud infrastructure combined with AI capabilities.
  • Vibrant Networking Opportunities: Connect with hundreds of passionate developers from your local community and potentially beyond. Share knowledge, discuss challenges, collaborate on ideas, and build valuable professional connections. 
  • Exploring the Latest Tools: Discover the newest Google developer tools and platforms designed to streamline AI development and Cloud deployment, enhancing your productivity and capabilities. 

No matter where you are in your coding journey—whether you're a beginner exploring your first programming language or a seasoned developer tackling complex challenges—our community is here to support, inspire, and grow with you. 💡

Let’s learn, share, and create the future of technology together! 🚀

chapter.description:
GDG Lisbon – Technology with Purpose, Community with Impact

We are a vibrant, volunteer-led community where tech enthusiasts, students, researchers, designers, product professionals, and others come together to share, learn, and grow.

We're part of the global Google Developer Groups (GDG) program

  • A network with over 600 chapters and GDG Lisbon is one of the many active groups in Portugal, organizing inclusive, impactful, and free events since 2010.

  • From tech talks and hands-on workshops to DevFest, Build with AI, and Women Techmakers events, we foster inclusive spaces to explore:

  • Google and open-source technologies (Android, Flutter, Firebase, Google Cloud, AI)

  • Topics like neurodiversity in tech, accessibility, sustainable innovation, and ethical development

Networking with Lisbon’s local tech ecosystem and global developer communities

We run open and free meetups, workshops, conferences, and global initiatives like:

  • DevFest (our biggest annual developer conference)

  • Build with AI (bringing real AI tools to the community)

  • Women Techmakers (advancing visibility, participation & leadership of women in tech)

We’re here to support developers, designers, researchers, students, and tech professionals of all levels who want to:

🌍 Learn new skills
🤝 Connect with other passionate people
🎤 Share their experience and grow together

Whether you're into Google Cloud, Firebase, Android, Flutter, AI/ML, design systems or accessibility — or you just want to explore the tech scene in Lisbon — this is the place.

Our community is:

✅ Volunteer-led
✅ Beginner-friendly
✅ Committed to diversity and inclusion
✅ Focused on learning, not selling

What we are:

✅ A free, inclusive, community-led space for continuous learning
✅ A place to co-create, speak, volunteer, and connect
✅ A supportive network where innovation meets collaboration

What we’re not:

❌ A sales platform
❌ A closed or exclusive group
❌ Focused on consumer or end-user content

👉 Whether you're a beginner or expert, everyone is welcome. Join us on our mission to build technology with purpose. Let’s build together — and make tech better for everyone.
https://developers.google.com/community/gdg

Bienvenido a Google Developer Group (GDG) Caracas

Bienvenido a Google Developer Group (GDG) Caracas, la comunidad oficial de desarrolladores de Google en Caracas, Venezuela.

Somos una comunidad abierta, liderada por voluntarios y respaldada por el programa global de Google Developer Groups. Nuestro propósito es conectar a estudiantes, desarrolladores, investigadores, emprendedores y profesionales de la tecnología para aprender, compartir experiencias y construir juntos el futuro de la innovación.

Creemos que el conocimiento alcanza su mayor impacto cuando se comparte. Cada experiencia, idea y aprendizaje tiene el potencial de inspirar a otros y generar soluciones que contribuyan al desarrollo de nuestra sociedad. Por ello, promovemos una comunidad inclusiva, colaborativa y accesible, donde cualquier persona interesada en la tecnología sea bienvenida, sin importar su nivel de experiencia.

Nuestra misión

Impulsar el crecimiento del ecosistema tecnológico venezolano mediante el aprendizaje continuo, la colaboración y el fortalecimiento de comunidades técnicas alrededor de las tecnologías de Google y las tendencias que están transformando la industria.

Buscamos formar profesionales mejor preparados, fomentar el liderazgo técnico y acercar oportunidades de aprendizaje de nivel internacional a nuestra comunidad.

Nuestras iniciativas

Organizamos actividades gratuitas durante todo el año alineadas con los programas globales de Google Developer Groups, ofreciendo espacios para aprender, experimentar y conectar con otros miembros de la comunidad.

🚀 Build with AI

Eventos prácticos donde exploramos Inteligencia Artificial Generativa, agentes inteligentes, modelos de lenguaje y el desarrollo de aplicaciones impulsadas por IA utilizando tecnologías de Google.

📚 Google Cloud Study Jams

Sesiones de aprendizaje colaborativo para fortalecer habilidades técnicas mediante laboratorios guiados, rutas de estudio y preparación para certificaciones de Google Cloud.

🔬 AI for Science

Encuentros dirigidos a estudiantes, docentes, investigadores y profesionales interesados en aplicar la Inteligencia Artificial para acelerar la investigación científica, la educación y el desarrollo de soluciones de impacto social.

🌎 DevFest

Nuestra conferencia anual, donde reunimos a la comunidad para compartir conocimiento, descubrir las últimas tendencias tecnológicas y aprender de expertos nacionales e internacionales.

💻 Tech Talks & Workshops

Charlas técnicas, talleres prácticos y laboratorios sobre desarrollo de software, arquitectura, cloud computing, datos, inteligencia artificial y tecnologías emergentes del ecosistema Google.

🤝 Community Meetups

Espacios para hacer networking, intercambiar experiencias, presentar proyectos y fortalecer la comunidad tecnológica local.

Crecemos como comunidad

Creemos que las comunidades más fuertes son aquellas donde cada miembro tiene la oportunidad de aprender, enseñar y contribuir.

Por ello, promovemos el crecimiento de nuestros integrantes como:

  • 🎤 Speakers y facilitadores técnicos.

  • 👩‍🏫 Mentores y líderes de comunidad.

  • 🤝 Voluntarios y organizadores de eventos.

  • ✍️ Creadores de contenido técnico.

  • 🌍 Contribuidores a proyectos Open Source.

  • ⭐ Futuros Google Developer Experts (GDEs).

  • 🚀 Líderes que impulsan nuevas iniciativas tecnológicas en la región.

Nuestro objetivo no es únicamente organizar eventos, sino ayudar a formar la próxima generación de líderes técnicos de nuestra comunidad.

¿Quién puede unirse?

Nuestra comunidad reúne personas de distintos perfiles, incluyendo: estudiantes universitarios y recién graduados, desarrolladores de software, ingenieros de datos e Inteligencia Artificial, profesionales de Cloud Computing, docentes e investigadores, emprendedores y startups tecnológicas, personas que desean iniciar una carrera en tecnología, cualquier persona con interés en aprender y compartir conocimiento. No importa si estás comenzando o cuentas con años de experiencia: siempre encontrarás un espacio para aprender, colaborar y crecer.

¿Por qué unirte?

Al formar parte de GDG Caracas podrás: participar en eventos técnicos gratuitos, aprender de expertos nacionales e internacionales, conectar con otros desarrolladores de la comunidad, descubrir nuevas tecnologías y buenas prácticas, acceder a recursos y programas de aprendizaje de Google, conocer oportunidades de becas, certificaciones y comunidades globales, desarrollar habilidades técnicas, profesionales y de liderazgo.

¡Únete a nuestra comunidad!

Si te apasiona la tecnología y quieres crecer junto a una comunidad colaborativa, GDG Caracas es el lugar para ti.

Te invitamos a participar en nuestros eventos, compartir tus conocimientos y formar parte de una red global de desarrolladores que construyen el futuro de la tecnología.

(BG) Пловдив е естественото пресечно пространство между технологиите, бизнеса и академичния свят, а нашата общност пулсира точно в сърцето на тази среща.

Google Developer Group Plovdiv и Women Techmakers Plovdiv обединяват енергия и визия, за да развият отворена, смела и подкрепяща среда за хора от абсолютно всяка възраст и житейски етап. Тук технологиите не плашат, а вдъхновяват и отварят врати.

Събираме на едно място любопитни ученици, мотивирани студенти, отдадени учители, смели стартъп основатели, опитни инженери и професионалисти от всички сфери. Чрез практически работилници, живи демонстрации и смислени разговори превръщаме идеите в реални проекти, уменията в практически опит, а иновациите в достъпен инструмент за всеки.

Нашата цел е ясна: да правим съвременните технологии разбираеми и достъпни, да насърчаваме смелите идеи и да изграждаме истински мост между образованието, таланта и реалния сектор. Даваме пространство на любопитството, упоритостта и амбицията и празнуваме успехите на жените и младите визионери, които превръщат идеите си в реалност и създават дигиталното утре.

Без значение дали пишете код от десетилетие, правите първи стъпки в училище, сменяте професионалния си път или просто искате да разберете как работи светът около вас, тук имате своето сигурно място за израстване.

✨ Станете част от общността;

✨ Учете чрез реална практика, споделяйте опит и откривайте съмишленици;

✨ Бъдете двигател на технологичното развитие в Пловдив и в цяла България.

Следете публикациите ни и създавайте бъдещето заедно с нас.

(EN) Plovdiv is where technology, dynamic industry, and academia converge, and our community thrives right at the core of this momentum.

Google Developer Group Plovdiv and Women Techmakers Plovdiv have joined forces to build an open, ambitious, and welcoming space designed for every generation and every stage of growth. Here, technology is never intimidating; it is empowering, practical, and accessible.

We bring together young learners, university students, visionary educators, experienced developers, creative designers, and business leaders under one collaborative roof. Through hands-on workshops, real-world hackathons, and honest conversations, curiosity turns into working solutions, skills become tangible confidence, and shared ideas spark meaningful collaborations.

Our mission is grounded and purposeful: we demystify emerging technologies, bridge the gap between classroom learning and the tech sector, and champion diverse voices, especially women shaping the modern tech landscape.

Whether you are a seasoned software architect, an enthusiastic high school builder, a career changer taking your first leap, or someone curious about what comes next, you belong here. This is your platform to experiment, connect, and thrive.

Follow our updates and build the future with us.

Pelo contrário, a palavra de ordem é inclusão de todas as pessoas e suas identididades.Queremos uma comunidade forte, com muitos membros que possam auxiliar o desenvolvimento local, engajados em crescer como seres humanos, mas contribuindo para o crescimento do entorno também.Desejamos que cada vez mais pessoas se sintam representadas nos espaços que o GDG João Pessoa atua, por isso convidamos a todos e todas participarem, junto conosco, na construção da nossa comunidade.

chapter.description:
Our Mission: Connecting and Growing Baltimore's Developers

Google Developer Group (GDG) Baltimore is a local community for developers to connect and learn together. We are a volunteer-run group, supported by Google, with a mission to build a strong, inclusive, and skilled tech community in the heart of Maryland.

This global community prides itself on being an inclusive environment. We welcome everyone interested in tech, from beginners to experienced developers.

What We Do: Your Hub for Google Technology

We host a variety of events tailored to the interests of the Baltimore tech scene, from downtown startups to the academic hubs at local universities. Our events provide hands-on learning, expert insights, and invaluable networking opportunities.

Our key initiatives include:

  • Build with AI: These community-led, hands-on events help developers of all skill levels (including backend, Android, and Flutter) acquire and apply Generative AI skills using Gemini, Gemma, and Vertex AI.

  • Road to Google Developers Certification: We provide the resources and community support to help you prepare for and earn professional Google Cloud certifications, such as Cloud Architect, Data Engineer, and Machine Learning Engineer.

  • StartathonAI: An AI-powered startup immersive experience where participants use LLMs to build comprehensive business plans and compete in a pitch competition judged by VCs and industry experts.

  • Building for Everyone: In partnership with Google's Accessibility teams, we run events to educate developers on incorporating accessibility best practices and tools into their products.

  • Social & Networking Events: Connect with your peers at our "Tap and Tech" or "Small Business AI Clinique" events.

Who Should Join?

Our community is a vibrant mix of:

  • Students from University of Maryland, Baltimore County (UMBC), Johns Hopkins University, University of Baltimore, MICA, CCBC, BCCC, and other local institutions.

  • Professionals working in Baltimore's thriving tech, cybersecurity, health-tech, and government contracting sectors.

  • Startup Founders and entrepreneurs looking to leverage AI and Cloud technologies.

  • Career Changers and new developers seeking to build foundational skills.

  • Anyone curious about the future of technology!

Join GDG Baltimore today to connect with your local tech community, get free access to courses and Google Cloud credits, and build the next generation of technology.


Disclaimer: GDG Baltimore is an independent group; our activities and the opinions expressed here should in no way be linked to Google, the corporation. To learn more about the GDG program, visit https://developers.google.com/community/gdg

GDG (Google Developer Groups) is a global project by Google Developers Department, a community of people interested in Google and other open source technologies, including Web/Chrome, Android, ML, Flutter and other Google APIs. GDG Zhenghzou is one of the many GDG communities that have formed in major cities around the world. Here you can learn about Google's latest technologies, products and information, as well as find technical exchange and discussion partners, make friends and expand your horizons in the national and global GDG. The organizers of the community are all Internet professionals from various industries, and we need more new blood to join. If you're interested in Google Technologies, have deployable spare time, share the community's values, and would like to contribute to the community, join us as a community volunteer!

GDG , 即 Google Developer Groups 谷歌开发者社区，是谷歌开发者部门发起的全球项目。GDG 是面向对 Google 和开源技术感兴趣的人群而存在的公益性开发者社区，内容涵盖 Web/Chrome、Android、机器学习、Flutter 和其它 Google API 等。全世界各大城市都成立了自己的 GDG 社区，GDG Zhenghzou （郑州谷歌开发者社区）也是其中之一。在这里，你能更及时地了解 Google 最新技术、产品与信息，也能在全国乃至全球 GDG 中，找到技术交流、讨论问题的伙伴，结交朋友、开拓视野。社区中的各位组织者均是来自各个行业有着本职工作的互联网从业者，我们需要更多新鲜血液的加入！如果你对谷歌技术感兴趣，业余时间可调配，认同社区的价值观，愿意为社区做出贡献，欢迎加入我们成为社区志愿者！

Welcome to Google Developers Group (GDG) Ahlen - Where Innovation Thrives! 

🌟 Whether online or in-person, our events are crafted to inspire, educate, and connect individuals passionate about technology and innovation. 

💡Why Join GDG Ahlen?

🔥Join us at Google Developer Group Ahlen in NRW, Germany, and be part of a dynamic community of tech enthusiasts, lifelong learners, and forward-thinking developers. 

  • 🌍 Ahlen is a city that distinctively blends rich history with a forward-thinking spirit. 
  • 🐘 Our most unique local symbol is the Mammoth , commemorating the prehistoric woolly mammoth fossils discovered right here. This connection to ancient discovery provides a powerful backdrop for your modern innovations.
  • 📹 Our YouTube channel @GDGAhlen 

What Awaits You at GDG Ahlen

  • Insightful Tech Talks & Sessions: Learn directly from Google engineers, Google Developer Experts (GDEs), and industry leaders. 
  • Dive deep into the practical integration of AI 🧠 and Cloud ☁️ technologies, exploring best practices, new tools, and successful implementation strategies. 
  • Hands-On Workshops, Hackathons, Get certified sessions, Codelabs: Move beyond theory and gain practical skills! Participate in interactive sessions where you can experiment with the latest AI/Cloud platforms and tools to build innovative and scalable applications. 
  • Focus on Responsible Innovation: Engage in crucial discussions and learn techniques for building ethically sound AI solutions. Explore topics like fairness, transparency, privacy, and the responsible scaling of AI-driven systems. 
  • Deep Dives into Architecture: Understand how to design robust, scalable, and future-proof systems leveraging the power of Cloud infrastructure combined with AI capabilities.

chapter.description:
GDG Nairobi is the Nairobi chapter of Google Developer Groups, a global network of 2,000+ volunteer-led communities where developers connect, learn, and grow around Google's technologies. We are the local home for anyone curious about Android, Web, Cloud, Firebase, and AI, whether you are writing your first line of code or shipping to millions.

What we do

We run events all year round, including the Nairobi editions of Google's global developer programs:

  • DevFest, the community tech conference hosted by GDGs all over the world toward the end of each year.

  • Google I/O Extended, where we bring the announcements and energy from Google I/O home to Nairobi.

  • Build with AI, hands-on sessions with Google's latest AI tools and models.

On top of these, we host our own hackathons, workshops, and study jams throughout the year. The vast majority of our events are free because we believe the only barrier to learning should be your curiosity, not your budget.

More than code

We are a community of communities. We work hand in hand with Women Techmakers, Google Developer Experts (GDEs), fellow GDG chapters across Africa, and other tech communities to grow the ecosystem and open doors for the next generation of builders. The goal is simple: make Kenya's tech scene one of the strongest in the world, and have a good time building it together.

Come build with us

9,000+ members and counting. Whether you want to learn something new, share what you know, or simply meet people who get excited about the same things you do, there is a seat for you here. Join us at our next event. All we ask is that you read and respect our Code of Conduct.

GDG Nairobi is an independent, community-run group. Our activities and opinions are our own and are not affiliated with or endorsed by Google. To learn more about the GDG program, visit developers.google.com/community/gdg.
chapter.title: GDG Nairobi

chapter.description:
GDG Melbourne is for anyone interested in developing and learning about Android and other exciting Google related technologies. We cover such topics as Kotlin, Java, Flutter, Firebase, Machine Learning, VR & AR, Google Assistant, Wearables and IoT.

Regardless of your skill level or experience, it's a fun and open environment, so we'd love to have you come along! Some of the events we hold are:

• Monthly Meetups
Melbourne CBD, on the last Wednesday of each month.
We typically have two lightning (10-15 minute) talks coupled with a longer (20-30 minute) presentation.  Each meetup also includes time to talk and network, a summary of new releases and local developer introductions. We often then head to a nearby pub. Catering is provided.

• Coding Nights
Melbourne CBD, on the second last Wednesday of each month.
Coding nights are hosted in a casual environment to allow you to network with like minded developers and work on your own projects. Experts, colleagues and peers are on hand to help you out with problems and to collaborate on projects. Catering is provided.

• Special events
Typically one-off events such as a Google I/O Extended (a recap of the event and announcements), Study Jams (free training sessions), DevFest (one day conference) or social events like Christmas parties.

Learn more on our website

Keep up to date on all thing GDG Melbourne or join the discussions on:

• Slack

• Twitter @GDGMelbourne

• Linkedin

• YouTube

All members are asked to act in accordance with our Code of Conduct

Creemos que el hecho de encontrarnos todos tan cerca, estudiando o trabajando en la Universidad de Málaga, puede ayudar a que estas experiencias y conocimientos nos lleguen más fácilmente. Siempre es mejor aprender en compañía y, ya de paso, divertirse en el proceso. :)

chapter.description:
Our Mission: Connecting and Growing Annapolis' Developers

Google Developer Group (GDG) Annapolis is a local community for developers to connect and learn together. We are a volunteer-run group, supported by Google, with a mission to build a strong, inclusive, and skilled tech community in the heart of Maryland.

This global community prides itself on being an inclusive environment. We welcome everyone interested in tech, from beginners to experienced developers.

What We Do: Your Hub for Google Technology

We host a variety of events tailored to the interests of the Baltimore tech scene, from downtown startups to the academic hubs at local universities. Our events provide hands-on learning, expert insights, and invaluable networking opportunities.

Our key initiatives include:

  • Build with AI: These community-led, hands-on events help developers of all skill levels (including backend, Android, and Flutter) acquire and apply Generative AI skills using Gemini, Gemma, and Vertex AI.

  • Road to Google Developers Certification: We provide the resources and community support to help you prepare for and earn professional Google Cloud certifications, such as Cloud Architect, Data Engineer, and Machine Learning Engineer.

  • StartathonAI: An AI-powered startup immersive experience where participants use LLMs to build comprehensive business plans and compete in a pitch competition judged by VCs and industry experts.

  • Building for Everyone: In partnership with Google's Accessibility teams, we run events to educate developers on incorporating accessibility best practices and tools into their products.

  • Social & Networking Events: Connect with your peers at our "Tap and Tech" or "Small Business AI Clinique" events.

Who Should Join?

Our community is a vibrant mix of:

  • Students from University of Maryland, Baltimore County (UMBC), Johns Hopkins University, University of Baltimore, MICA, CCBC, BCCC, and other local institutions.

  • Professionals working in Baltimore's thriving tech, cybersecurity, health-tech, and government contracting sectors.

  • Startup Founders and entrepreneurs looking to leverage AI and Cloud technologies.

  • Career Changers and new developers seeking to build foundational skills.

  • Anyone curious about the future of technology!

Join GDG Annapolis today to connect with your local tech community, get free access to courses and Google Cloud credits, and build the next generation of technology.

Interesting Links:

  • Google Developer Community on Discord: https://discord.com/invite/google-dev-community

  • Google Developer Program: https://developers.google.com/program

  • GDG Annapolis Group on Linked in: https://www.linkedin.com/groups/13097329/
